extDesc.message: Batch-export Feishu / Lark docs as Markdown, Word or PDF in one zip. Images are saved locally — their links expire in about 24h.

actionTitle.message: Feishu batch export: show or hide the panel

fabTip.message: Click to open the panel, drag to move it

repoTip.message: Source code and issues on GitHub

langTip.message: Panel language. The extension name and toolbar tooltip always follow the browser

srcTip.message: Where to look. A wiki needs a wiki document open; the drive works from any page

emptyInvite.message: Pick a source, then hit “List documents”.

recentTip.message: Select by last-modified date — useful for incremental backups

fmtAutoTip.message: On “Auto”: documents become Markdown; sheets and bases become xlsx

optImagesTip.message: Only affects documents exported as Markdown. Feishu's image links expire in about 24 hours — leave them and the pictures are gone within days

optCommentTip.message: Exports the discussion thread along with the document

optDirsTip.message: Mirror the original hierarchy as subfolders inside the zip instead of flattening it

optNumTip.message: Like 001-Title.md. Numbering restarts at 001 inside each folder

optParentTip.message: Like Parent-Title.md. Redundant while “Keep folder structure” is on

hintCascade.message: Checking a folder checks everything under it. Alt-click to affect only that row.

hintTri.message: A dash in the box means that row isn't selected, but something under it is.

notExportable.message: $1 isn't supported: its FreeMind export is generated in Feishu's own frontend — there is no server endpoint to call

emptyFailed.message: Nothing listed. Check you can open this document, or try the other source.

errNotWiki.message: This isn't a wiki document page. Open one, or switch the source to Drive

errNotJson.message: HTTP $1, and the response wasn't JSON

imgFailed.message: One image didn't load, link left as-is · $1

selectedRecent.message: Edited in the last $1 days: $2 selected
